verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs claim it is 'typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model,' directly supporting the story, but this is a single first-party claim with no independent corroboration, no examples of specific models and turnaround times, and no SLA. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of fast release turnaround, concrete examples of specific model launches with timestamps, and any commitment/SLA on release speed.
